notes: Inspired by @PodvsEnemies episode 139 from 13 May 2025 (https://open.spotify.com/episode/0m6Sfdv88fNZmYm9A6PdVR?si=140d643338154357) with @ImpetusAlways @CourtProjects and @Saint_Kabr (PvE PvE-MinorSpec PvE-God PvE-EndGame M+KB Controller): First-choice PvE pick for clearing Minor adds in both general at-level or better, and end-game underleveled content, particularly with stasis builds. Liminal Vigil is the only Stasis Heavy Burst sidearm currently in the game - the intrinsic frame perk reduces flinch slightly when you're ADSing. At base, by comparison with its peers, the stats are good - d2foundry.gg calculates that 58 Range equates to 15.98m ADS and 13.32m hipfire before damage dropoff, 39 Stability is ×1.1427 flinch resist at 100 Resilience, 30 Handling is 0.33s ready, 0.27s ADS and 0.36s stow speed, 20 Reload Speed is a 1.91s reload, Recoil Direction is 94, Zoom is 12, and magazine size is 26 (max 40). A little bit of Stability and Handling from the barrel perk are useful to improve gunfeel and control, particularly if you're spamming shots. For the magazine perk, the combat effect magazines all add utility, or look to speed up the reload a bit. For Stasis builds, the combination of Headstone and Rimestealer should generate crystals and shards to proc fragment effects, and apply Frost Armor to help keep you alive while you're in CQC. The Tex Balanced Stock is there if you like hipfiring, but the Gravity Well origin trait can be very useful to pick up ammo bricks within 5m on a manual reload. Recommended MW: Handling or Stability, with an Adept Backup Mag mod or, when masterworked, Synergy to create Stasis Shards or, when the artifact mod's around, Stunloader.

warlockmaggie (PvE / M+KB / Controller): "True story, I had yet to have a Liminal Vigil drop until Rite of the Nine! Anyways, this Heavy Burst sidearm has some interesting perks to choose from: the obvious stasis wombo-combo, EA + KC, or the potential of Attrition Orbs and Desperate Measures feeding orbs into your abilities which in turn feed a damage buff. Heavy Burst suffer from poor Handling and Reload, so feel free to increase those as you see fit." Recommended MW: Handling or Reload Speed

warlockmaggie (PvP / M+KB / Controller): "I've not done a ton of PvP with Heavy Burst sidearms, but Liminal Vigil does pack some potency in its perks. Perpetual Motion and Kill Clip feels quite free and synergizes nicely (A BLISTERING .47s TTK no less!). While the range is decent, the handling is quite poor, so definitely work to bring that up if at all possible." Recommended MW: Range or Handling
